entities.name: GCTB
observations: Giant cell tumor of bone; H3F3A glycine-34 mutations were reported in 96% in a 412-bone-tumor study (PMID:27499898).

entities.name: Sporadic GCLJ
observations: Sporadic giant cell lesions of the jaw; a 58-case study reported KRAS, FGFR1, or TRPV4 gain-of-function mutations in 42/58; retrieved abstract did not supply an H3F3A-specific denominator/result (PMID:30385747).

entities.name: PMID:27499898
observations: Study of 412 bone tumours reported H3F3A glycine-34 mutations in 96% of GCTB; retrieved text does not give the GCTB-specific denominator or exact count.

entities.name: PMID:30385747
observations: Study analyzed 58 sporadic giant cell lesions of the jaw and reported KRAS, FGFR1, or TRPV4 gain-of-function mutations in 42/58; retrieved text does not show an H3F3A-specific denominator/result.

entities.name: H3F3A GCTB prevalence
observations: H3F3A glycine-34 mutations were present in 96% of GCTB in a 412-bone-tumour study; the retrieved record does not report the GCTB subgroup denominator.

entities.name: Jaw lesion drivers
